name: Derelict: Station Kestrel
author: Patchwork
description: Science fiction. A mining station has gone dark and its distress beacon is still calling. Adds a premise, your docked shuttle as a start area, a medical bay and a reactor deck, generated corridors, maintenance shafts and hydroponics, plus a three-part story. Uses ship directions (fore, aft, port, starboard). Pair with Steel & Peril for rogue drones.
